answer: Ask the applicant to show a life, not a login. Council tax payment history with municipal attestation is the life, documented as payments logged for years by the municipal council. The pigment of the life is its messiness — fees paid late, addresses changed, names spelled two ways — a mess no script can invent cleanly. Reproducing that mess a hundred times means staging a hundred biographies, and the voyage of each staging is the rehearsal: every date must agree with every other record. The walnut that decides is the phone call to the office named in the record.
